mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate declines signal strong economic growth with tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS rise and UNRATE fall, or interaction effect not significant (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts below 1.2 million units signal weakening residential demand, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with HOUST < 1200, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained three-month increase in non-farm payroll employment signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three-month PAYEMS increase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline below 104.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with INDPRO < 104.0, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP contraction and industrial production decline signal broad economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters with GDPC1 decline and INDPRO fall, or interaction effect not significant (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes, a monthly CPI reading above 240.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.
